scenario: 面试官给的题是「给自动驾驶汽车(Waymo/Tesla/Amazon Robotics)设计一个物体检测系统」。
scenario_en: The interviewer says 'design an object detection system for an autonomous vehicle (Waymo/Tesla/Amazon Robotics)'.
q: 这道题真正在考什么？
q_en: What is this question really testing?
why: 别把它当调模型的题：它是完整系统设计——延迟预算、边缘硬件、安全认证、失败分析样样要答。真正拉开级别的是需求 scoping 的深度，不是模型选得多花哨。
why_en: Treat it as a full system-design problem with latency budget, edge hardware, safety certification, and failure analysis, where depth of requirements scoping, not model choice, separates the levels.
options: 主要是刷 mAP，挑精度最高的检测网络、在公开数据集上调到 SOTA 就算通关
主要是训练技巧：数据增强、超参搜索、换更深的 backbone，模型越大分越高
一个完整系统设计题：延迟预算、边缘硬件、安全认证、失败分析都要答，scoping 深浅区分级别
主要是标注工程：雇更多人画更多框，把数据集堆大就能覆盖所有长尾场景
options_en: Mostly chasing mAP: pick the most accurate detector and tune it to SOTA on a public dataset.
Mostly training tricks: augmentation, hyperparameter search, a deeper backbone; bigger scores higher.
A full system-design question: latency budget, edge hardware, safety certification, failure analysis, where scoping depth sets the level.
Mostly labeling engineering: hire more people to draw more boxes and cover the long tail by dataset size.
optionExplanations: mAP 只是精度一个侧面；这题重头在延迟、硬件、安全和失败分析，只刷分会被判成 L4。
训练技巧是模型内部细节；面试要系统级取舍，堆大模型反而违背边缘延迟预算。
对；它是端到端系统题，需求 scoping 的深浅(延迟/硬件/安全/失败)才是分级线。
堆数据解决不了长尾；这题先考需求框定，不是标注工程执行。
optionExplanations_en: mAP is only one slice of accuracy; this question centers on latency, hardware, safety, and failure, so score-chasing reads as L4.
Training tricks are model internals; the interview wants system-level tradeoffs, and bigger models fight the edge latency budget.
Correct — it is an end-to-end system question, and the depth of scoping across latency, hardware, safety, and failure is the leveling line.
More data cannot fix the long tail, and this question first tests requirement framing, not labeling execution.

termDefinitions.meaning: 自动驾驶车辆：靠传感器和感知模型自主行驶的车。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An AV (Autonomous Vehicle) drives itself using sensors and perception models.

termDefinitions.meaning: 跨类别、跨 IoU 阈值综合的物体检测精度指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: mAP (mean Average Precision) summarizes detection accuracy across classes and IoU thresholds.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把开放式题目拆成延迟、硬件、安全、数据等具体约束的过程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Requirements scoping is breaking an open prompt into concrete constraints like latency, hardware, safety, and data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 失败可能致命的系统，检测漏报直接关系人身安全。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Safety-critical means failures can be fatal, so a missed detection directly risks human life.

scenario: 高速上以 30 m/s 行驶，从相机出帧到控制系统动作必须极快。
scenario_en: Cruising at 30 m/s on the highway, camera-frame-to-control action must be extremely fast.
q: 端到端 50ms 这个目标从哪来，它约束了什么设计选择？
q_en: Where does the 50ms end-to-end target come from and what does it constrain?
why: 50ms 不是公式算出的，是给定的安全 SLO——30 m/s×50ms=1.5m 盲行距离，正好是紧急制动的最小余量。它是延迟预算总盘，逼推理只剩~30ms，从而排除顺序跑的两阶段检测。
why_en: The 50ms is a given safety SLO, not a computed number: at 30 m/s it means 1.5m of blind travel, the minimum emergency-braking margin, and it caps inference near 30ms which rules out sequential two-stage detectors.
diagram:
flowchart LR C["相机取帧
~5ms"] --> P["预处理 resize
~5ms"] P --> M["模型推理 edge GPU
~30ms 主导"] M --> N["NMS 后处理
~5ms"] N --> H["交给控制栈
~5ms"]
options: 50ms 只是 GPU 厂商标称的硬件上限，换更强芯片即可突破，跟刹车距离无关
50ms 是物理推出的安全目标：30 m/s×50ms≈1.5m 盲行，是急刹最小余量；它把推理压进 30ms，排除两阶段
50ms 是训练时每个 batch 的延迟指标，只影响训练吞吐，线上推理可放宽到几百毫秒
50ms 指每帧必须在此时间内被人工标注完成，是数据流水线时限，与实时推理无关
options_en: 50ms is just the GPU vendor's stated hardware ceiling; a stronger chip breaks it, unrelated to braking distance.
50ms is a physics-derived safety target: at 30 m/s it is ~1.5m of blind travel, the minimum braking margin, and it squeezes inference into 30ms, ruling out two-stage.
50ms is a per-batch training latency metric that only affects training throughput; serving can relax to hundreds of ms.
50ms is the per-frame human-annotation deadline, a data-pipeline limit unrelated to real-time inference.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给定的目标指标(如端到端 50ms)，不是公式推出的，而是安全/产品设定。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An SLO (Service Level Objective) is a given target like 50ms end-to-end, set by safety or product rather than derived.

termDefinitions.term: two-stage detector / 两阶段检测器
termDefinitions.meaning: 先出候选区域再逐个分类的检测器(如 Faster R-CNN)，两步串行、较慢。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A two-stage detector first proposes regions then classifies them, running serially and slower.

termDefinitions.meaning: 速度单位，30 m/s≈108 km/h，用来把延迟换算成盲行距离。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Meters per second; 30 m/s is about 108 km/h, used to convert latency into blind-travel distance.

q: 把 AV 检测端到端 50ms 延迟预算的 5 个阶段按执行顺序排好：
q_en: Order the five stages of the end-to-end 50ms AV-detection latency budget.
steps: NMS + 后处理：去掉重叠冗余框，~5ms
把检测结果交给控制/规划栈：~5ms
预处理并 resize 到网络输入尺寸：~5ms
模型推理 edge GPU：~30ms，主导项
why: 顺序：取帧→预处理 resize→模型推理(~30ms 主导)→NMS 去重叠框→交给控制。五段相加~50ms，推理是唯一大头，优化都往它使劲。
why_en: The order is capture, preprocess/resize, inference at about 30ms as the dominant stage, NMS to drop overlaps, then handoff to control, summing to about 50ms with inference the only big chunk.

termDefinitions.meaning: 非极大值抑制：同一物体上只保留置信度最高的框，删掉重叠冗余框。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NMS (Non-Maximum Suppression) keeps the highest-confidence box per object and removes overlapping duplicates.

scenario: 讨论为什么每多 50ms 延迟都危险。
scenario_en: Discussing why every extra 50ms of latency is dangerous.
q: 「30 m/s 下 100ms 延迟 ≈ 3m 盲行」这个数字对设计意味着什么？
q_en: What does '100ms of latency at 30 m/s is about 3m of blind travel' imply for design?
why: 车在你「看不见」的这段处理时间里一直在走：距离=速度×延迟。30 m/s×100ms=3m，×50ms=1.5m，这就是把延迟预算当安全指标压到 50ms 的物理依据。
why_en: The car keeps moving while it is 'blind': distance equals speed times latency, so 30 m/s over 100ms is 3m and over 50ms is 1.5m, which is why the latency budget is a safety metric pinned at 50ms.
options: 延迟直接换算成盲行：30 m/s×0.1s=3m，50ms 减半到 1.5m，所以延迟预算就是安全余量
3m 只是相机的可视距离，与处理延迟无关，提高分辨率就能看更远更安全
3m 指检测框的平均定位误差，是精度问题，靠更大模型把 mAP 提上去就能解决
3m 是两次曝光之间的位移，把帧率提到 60fps 就能消除，跟端到端延迟无关
options_en: Latency converts straight into blind travel: 30 m/s times 0.1s is 3m, halving to 1.5m at 50ms, so the latency budget is the safety margin.
3m is just the camera's visible range, unrelated to processing latency; higher resolution sees farther and safer.
3m is the box's average localization error, an accuracy issue solved by a bigger model with higher mAP.
3m is the displacement between two exposures, removable by pushing frame rate to 60fps, unrelated to end-to-end latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从相机出帧到系统做出反应的这段延迟里，车已经开过的距离。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Blind travel is the distance the car covers during the latency between a frame and the system's reaction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒处理帧数，衡量实时速度；提高它并不能消掉端到端处理延迟。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FPS (Frames Per Second) measures real-time throughput; raising it does not remove end-to-end processing latency.

scenario: 50ms 预算里五个阶段：取帧 5、预处理 5、推理 30、NMS 5、控制 5(单位 ms)。
scenario_en: In the 50ms budget the five stages are capture 5, preprocess 5, inference 30, NMS 5, control 5 (ms).
q: 优化端到端延迟时，第一刀该砍哪个阶段？
q_en: When optimizing end-to-end latency, which stage do you cut first?
why: 五段里推理占 30/50，是唯一主导项；其余四段各~5ms，砍到 0 也只省 20ms。所以边缘优化(量化、TensorRT、选单阶段)全部集中在推理这一段。
why_en: Inference is 30 of the 50ms and the only dominant stage, so all edge optimization targets it, since the other four stages sum to just 20ms even if zeroed out.
options: 取帧阶段：换更快的相机传感器最划算，能省下大半预算
NMS 后处理：去重叠框是整条流水线里最耗时的一步
控制交接：缩短车内总线通信能省下最多时间
模型推理：它占~30ms 是绝对主导项，量化、TensorRT、单阶段检测都在压这块
options_en: Capture: swapping in a faster camera sensor is the best deal, saving most of the budget.
NMS post-processing: dropping overlapping boxes is the costliest step in the whole pipeline.
Control handoff: shortening the in-vehicle bus communication saves the most time.
Model inference: at ~30ms it is the dominant term, which is what quantization, TensorRT, and single-stage detectors all attack.

termDefinitions.meaning: 装在车上的算力受限 GPU，推理就在它上面跑，不走云端。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An edge GPU is the power-limited on-vehicle GPU where inference runs, not in the cloud.

scenario: 推理只剩~30ms 的预算，要在这个窗口内检出所有物体。
scenario_en: Only ~30ms of budget is left for inference, and you must detect all objects inside that window.
q: 这个 30ms 窗口该选单阶段还是两阶段检测器？
q_en: Single-stage or two-stage detector for this 30ms window?
why: 30ms 排除了两阶段——区域提议→分类是顺序两步，跑不进预算；单阶段把检测当一次回归，多尺度特征图上直接出框和类别。
why_en: The 30ms budget rules out two-stage, whose region-proposal-then-classify runs sequentially, while single-stage treats detection as one regression pass that emits boxes and classes directly.
tradeoff: 单阶段(一次前向、够快) vs 两阶段(提议+分类两步、更准但顺序慢)
whenOtherWins: 离线场景(如高精地图标注、数据集预标)没有实时约束时，两阶段更高的定位精度更值得。
options: 两阶段 Faster R-CNN：先出区域提议再逐个分类，精度最高，30ms 也够用
先跑两阶段拿高精度，等实时性不够时再降分辨率临时补救
单阶段 YOLO/SSD：多尺度特征图上一次前向直接回归框+类别，卡进 30ms
30ms 内只能做图像分类，真正的物体检测必须放到云端去跑
options_en: Two-stage Faster R-CNN: propose regions then classify each; highest accuracy and 30ms is enough.
Run two-stage for accuracy first, then drop resolution as a patch when real-time fails.
Single-stage YOLO/SSD: one forward pass on multi-scale feature maps regresses boxes and classes, fitting 30ms.
In 30ms you can only do image classification; real object detection must run in the cloud.
optionExplanations: 两阶段的 RPN→分类是串行两步，延迟叠加，跑不进 30ms，精度再高也没用。
先慢后救本末倒置：降分辨率会掉召回，安全关键场景不能拿召回换速度。
对；单阶段一次前向就出框和类别，是把检测卡进 30ms 硬实时窗口的结构性选择。
把帧传云端往返延迟就爆预算，检测必须在车载边缘设备本地完成。
optionExplanations_en: Two-stage runs RPN then classification serially, stacking latency past 30ms, so accuracy cannot save it.
Slow-then-patch is backwards: dropping resolution costs recall, and safety-critical scenes cannot trade recall for speed.
Correct — single-stage emits boxes and classes in one pass, the structural choice that fits detection into the 30ms hard-real-time window.
Shipping frames to the cloud blows the budget on the round trip; detection must run locally on the edge device.

termDefinitions.term: single-stage detector / 单阶段检测器
termDefinitions.meaning: 一次前向从特征图直接回归框和类别的检测器(YOLO/SSD)，快。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A single-stage detector regresses boxes and classes from feature maps in one forward pass, making it fast.

termDefinitions.meaning: 经典单阶段检测器，一次前向预测所有框和类别。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: YOLO (You Only Look Once) is a classic single-stage detector predicting all boxes and classes in one pass.

termDefinitions.meaning: 另一款单阶段检测器，从多尺度特征图直接预测框。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SSD (Single Shot MultiBox Detector) predicts boxes directly from multi-scale feature maps in one shot.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两阶段检测器：RPN 先提区域，再逐个分类，精度高但慢。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Faster R-CNN is a two-stage detector whose RPN proposes regions then classifies each, accurate but slow.

q: 单阶段(YOLO/SSD)与两阶段(Faster R-CNN)在延迟上的根本差别是什么？
q_en: What is the fundamental latency difference between single-stage (YOLO/SSD) and two-stage (Faster R-CNN)?
why: 差别在流程结构：两阶段的 RPN→分类是串行两步，延迟叠加；单阶段把定位和分类压进一次前向，天然更适合 30ms 硬实时窗口。
why_en: The difference is pipeline structure: two-stage runs region proposals then classification serially so latencies stack, while single-stage folds localization and classification into one pass, fitting the 30ms window.
tradeoff: 单阶段(一次前向、低延迟) vs 两阶段(提议+分类、精度略高但慢)
diagram:
flowchart LR R["两阶段：区域提议"] --> Cl["再逐个分类
顺序慢"] F["单阶段：多尺度特征图"] --> O["一次直接回归
框+类别 快"]
options: 两阶段顺序两步：先 RPN 提区域、再逐个分类；单阶段一次前向直接出框+类别
单阶段要跑两遍网络、两阶段只跑一遍，所以两阶段反而更快更省
两者延迟基本相同，差别只在单阶段的定位精度天生更高
单阶段必须配 LiDAR 才能跑，两阶段用纯相机，差别在传感器而非流程
options_en: Two-stage is two serial steps: RPN proposes regions then classifies each; single-stage emits boxes and classes in one pass.
Single-stage runs the network twice and two-stage once, so two-stage is actually faster and cheaper.
Their latency is basically equal; the only difference is single-stage has inherently higher localization accuracy.
Single-stage needs LiDAR to run while two-stage uses cameras only; the difference is sensors, not pipeline.
optionExplanations: 对；两阶段串行叠加延迟，单阶段一次前向，这就是它能进 30ms 的根本原因。
说反了：单阶段只跑一遍、更快；两阶段多了区域提议这步反而更慢。
延迟并不相同：两阶段因串行步骤明显更慢，这正是被排除的原因。
两者都能用纯相机；差别在检测流程是几步，不在用什么传感器。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — two-stage stacks latency serially while single-stage runs one pass, which is exactly why it fits 30ms.
Backwards: single-stage runs once and is faster; two-stage adds the proposal step and is slower.
Latency is not equal: two-stage is clearly slower from its serial steps, which is why it is ruled out.
Both can run on cameras alone; the difference is how many steps the pipeline has, not the sensor.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两阶段检测器里先框出候选区域的子网络，是其额外的串行开销来源。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An RPN (Region Proposal Network) first proposes candidate regions in a two-stage detector, its extra serial cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用激光测距生成 3D 点云的传感器，可与相机融合，但不是单阶段检测的前提。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) uses laser ranging to build a 3D point cloud; useful for fusion but not required for single-stage detection.

scenario: 检测器在一个物体上常吐出好几个高度重叠的框。
scenario_en: The detector often emits several highly overlapping boxes on a single object.
q: 延迟预算里的 NMS 这一步是干什么的？
q_en: What does the NMS step in the latency budget do?
why: NMS=Non-Maximum Suppression，非极大值抑制：按置信度排序，抑制与最高分框 IoU 超阈值的重叠框，避免一个行人被报成五个。它在后处理占~5ms。
why_en: NMS, non-maximum suppression, keeps the highest-confidence box per object and suppresses overlaps above an IoU threshold, so one pedestrian is not reported five times, costing about 5ms.
options: 把图像 resize 到网络输入尺寸
去掉同一物体上重叠冗余的框，每类只留置信度最高的那个
把 FP32 权重量化成 INT8 以加速推理
在多帧之间跟踪同一物体的 ID
options_en: Resize the image to the network's input dimensions.
Remove overlapping duplicate boxes on one object, keeping the highest-confidence box per class.
Quantize FP32 weights to INT8 to speed up inference.
Track the same object's ID across multiple frames.
optionExplanations: resize 是预处理阶段的事，和 NMS 无关。
对；NMS 按置信度+IoU 抑制重叠框，把一堆重复框收敛成每个物体一个。
量化是部署侧的权重压缩，NMS 不改精度格式。
跨帧跟踪是 tracking 模块的活，NMS 只在单帧内去重。
optionExplanations_en: Resizing happens in preprocessing and has nothing to do with NMS.
Correct — NMS suppresses overlaps by confidence and IoU, collapsing duplicate boxes into one per object.
Quantization is deployment-side weight compression; NMS does not change numeric format.
Cross-frame tracking is the tracker's job; NMS only deduplicates within a single frame.

termDefinitions.meaning: 非极大值抑制：抑制与最高分框重叠过多的冗余框，每物体留一个。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NMS (Non-Maximum Suppression) suppresses boxes that overlap the top-scoring one too much, leaving one per object.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个框交集面积除以并集面积，衡量重叠程度，NMS 用它设阈值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IoU (Intersection over Union) is intersection area over union area, measuring box overlap; NMS thresholds on it.

scenario: 汇报检测系统效果时要同时给精度和速度两个指标。
scenario_en: Reporting the detector's results, you must give both an accuracy metric and a speed metric.
q: 物体检测最常用的精度与速度指标分别是什么？
q_en: What are the standard accuracy and speed metrics for object detection?
why: mAP=mean Average Precision，跨类别、跨 IoU 阈值综合的检测精度；FPS=Frames Per Second，每秒帧数即实时速度。L4 至少要同时给这两个，光有精度不谈速度过不了实时关。
why_en: mAP (mean average precision) summarizes accuracy across classes and IoU thresholds while FPS (frames per second) captures speed, and you must report both because accuracy without speed fails the real-time bar.
options: 用 BLEU 衡量精度、用 QPS 衡量速度
用准确率 accuracy 衡量精度、用 batch size 衡量速度
用困惑度 perplexity 衡量精度、用 epoch 数衡量速度
用 mAP 衡量精度、用 FPS 衡量速度
options_en: Use BLEU for accuracy and QPS for speed.
Use classification accuracy for precision and batch size for speed.
Use perplexity for accuracy and epoch count for speed.
Use mAP for accuracy and FPS for speed.
optionExplanations: BLEU 是机器翻译指标、QPS 是服务吞吐，都不是检测精度/速度的标准量。
单一 accuracy 不适合多框检测；batch size 是训练超参不是实时速度。
perplexity 是语言模型指标，epoch 是训练轮数，都跟检测无关。
对；mAP 综合定位与分类精度，FPS 表实时速度，是检测的标准双指标。
optionExplanations_en: BLEU is a translation metric and QPS is service throughput; neither is detection accuracy or speed.
Plain accuracy does not fit multi-box detection, and batch size is a training hyperparameter, not real-time speed.
Perplexity is a language-model metric and epochs are training rounds, both unrelated to detection.
Correct — mAP blends localization and classification accuracy while FPS is real-time speed, the standard pair.

termDefinitions.meaning: 跨类别、跨 IoU 阈值平均的检测精度指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: mAP (mean Average Precision) averages detection precision across classes and IoU thresholds.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒处理帧数，衡量实时推理速度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FPS (Frames Per Second) is how many frames are processed per second, measuring real-time speed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 机器翻译文本相似度指标，与物体检测无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BLEU is a machine-translation text-similarity metric, unrelated to object detection.

termDefinitions.meaning: 语言模型预测下一个 token 的不确定度指标，与检测无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Perplexity measures a language model's uncertainty predicting the next token, unrelated to detection.

scenario: 模型不在云端 GPU 跑，而是装在车上的芯片里。
scenario_en: The model does not run on cloud GPUs but on a chip inside the vehicle.
q: AV 物体检测的部署环境有什么关键约束？
q_en: What is the key deployment constraint for AV object detection?
why: 车上是边缘设备，FLOPS、内存带宽都有限，还断不起网——不能把帧传云端(往返延迟就爆了 50ms 预算)。这逼你做量化、TensorRT 编译、选轻量单阶段模型。
why_en: The model runs on power- and bandwidth-limited edge chips and cannot offload frames to the cloud because the round trip alone blows the 50ms budget, which forces quantization, TensorRT, and lightweight single-stage models.
options: 跑在车载边缘设备(Jetson、Tesla FSD 芯片、ASIC)上，FLOPS 与带宽受限
跑在数据中心的大 GPU 集群上，算力近乎无限，只需关心批处理吞吐
跑在用户手机上，靠 5G 把每帧上传云端推理、再把结果回传回来
跑在普通 CPU 上即可，检测对算力要求低，不需要专用加速硬件
options_en: It runs on power- and bandwidth-limited in-vehicle edge devices (Jetson, Tesla FSD chip, ASICs).
It runs on a large data-center GPU cluster with near-unlimited compute, so only batch throughput matters.
It runs on the user's phone, uploading each frame over 5G to the cloud and getting results back.
A plain CPU suffices; detection is compute-light and needs no dedicated accelerator.
optionExplanations: 对；车载边缘算力/带宽有限，还得本地实时，这决定了所有部署侧优化。
云端集群的假设错了：车上没有无限算力，也承受不了云端往返延迟。
每帧上云往返延迟直接爆 50ms 预算，安全系统不能依赖网络。
实时多物体检测算力需求高，纯 CPU 达不到 30ms 推理，需专用加速。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — on-vehicle edge compute and bandwidth are limited and must run locally in real time, which drives every deployment optimization.
The cloud-cluster assumption is wrong: the car has no unlimited compute and cannot absorb cloud round-trip latency.
Uploading each frame blows the 50ms budget on the round trip, and a safety system cannot depend on the network.
Real-time multi-object detection is compute-heavy; a plain CPU cannot hit 30ms inference and needs an accelerator.

termDefinitions.meaning: 部署在数据产生现场(车上)的算力受限硬件，就地推理不依赖云。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An edge device is compute-limited hardware deployed where data is produced (the vehicle), inferring locally without the cloud.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒浮点运算次数，衡量算力；边缘设备的 FLOPS 有限。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FLOPS (Floating Point Operations Per Second) measures compute capacity, which is limited on edge devices.

termDefinitions.meaning: 为特定任务(如推理)定制的专用芯片，能效比通用 GPU 高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An ASIC (Application-Specific Integrated Circuit) is a chip customized for one task like inference, more efficient than a general GPU.

termDefinitions.meaning: Tesla 自研的车载自动驾驶推理芯片。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The FSD (Full Self-Driving) chip is Tesla's in-house on-vehicle inference chip.

scenario: 边缘芯片内存和带宽有限，FP32 模型太大太慢。
scenario_en: Edge chip memory and bandwidth are limited, and the FP32 model is too big and slow.
q: 把模型从 FP32 量化到 FP16/INT8 有什么收益和代价？
q_en: What are the benefits and costs of quantizing the model from FP32 to FP16/INT8?
why: 量化用更少 bit 表示权重/激活(FP32→INT8 是 32→8 bit)，内存和带宽都降，还能用芯片的低精度计算单元加速；代价是数值精度下降，需校准防止掉点。
why_en: Quantization stores weights and activations in fewer bits (FP32 to INT8 is 32 down to 8), cutting memory and bandwidth and using the chip's low-precision units for speed, at the cost of accuracy you calibrate to protect.
options: 量化会增大模型内存占用，但换来更高精度，适合安全关键场景
量化只是改变权重的存储格式，对推理速度和内存都没有实质影响
FP32 降到 FP16/INT8：省内存、走低精度计算单元加速，代价是可能掉一点精度
量化就是把输入图片分辨率降低以减少计算量，和模型权重无关
options_en: Quantization increases memory footprint but buys higher accuracy, ideal for safety-critical use.
Quantization only changes the weight storage format with no real effect on speed or memory.
FP32 down to FP16/INT8: saves memory and uses low-precision compute units for speed, at the cost of some accuracy.
Quantization means lowering input image resolution to cut compute, unrelated to model weights.
optionExplanations: 反了：量化是减小内存、可能略降精度，不是增大内存换精度。
格式变了 bit 数就变了，内存和低精度算力都受益，不是没影响。
对；用更少 bit 换内存、带宽和速度，代价是精度略降，需校准。
量化改的是权重/激活的数值精度，不是图片分辨率，两者别混。
optionExplanations_en: Backwards: quantization shrinks memory and may slightly cut accuracy, not the reverse.
Fewer bits changes memory and lets low-precision units help, so it is not a no-op.
Correct — fewer bits trade memory, bandwidth, and speed for a small accuracy drop you calibrate.
Quantization changes weight/activation numeric precision, not image resolution; do not conflate them.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把权重/激活从高精度浮点降到低 bit 表示，省内存、算力，略损精度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Quantization lowers weights and activations from high-precision floats to fewer bits, saving memory and compute at some accuracy cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 32 位浮点数，训练默认精度，占内存大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FP32 (32-bit Floating Point) is the default training precision and uses more memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 16 位浮点数，半精度，省一半内存。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FP16 (16-bit Floating Point) is half precision, halving memory use.

termDefinitions.meaning: 8 位整数，量化最激进档，内存/算力最省但精度损失最大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: INT8 (8-bit Integer) is the most aggressive quantization, cheapest in memory and compute but with the largest accuracy loss.

scenario: 同一个模型直接跑和用厂商工具编译后跑，速度差很多。
scenario_en: The same model runs much faster after being compiled by the vendor's tool than run as-is.
q: TensorRT 在部署里起什么作用？
q_en: What role does TensorRT play in deployment?
why: TensorRT 是 NVIDIA 的推理优化编译器：把训练好的图针对目标 GPU 重编译——融合相邻层、删冗余算子、选最优 kernel，从而压低那 30ms 推理。它是部署侧优化，不改精度目标。
why_en: TensorRT is NVIDIA's inference compiler that re-optimizes a trained graph for the target GPU via layer fusion, redundancy elimination, and kernel selection to shrink that 30ms inference, without changing the accuracy target.
options: 一个数据标注工具，用来给训练帧画 3D 边界框
把计算图编译成硬件专属执行计划，做层融合、消冗余来加速推理
一种新的检测网络结构，用来替代 YOLO 当主干网络
一个云端训练框架，负责多卡分布式训练调度
options_en: A data-annotation tool for drawing 3D bounding boxes on training frames.
It compiles the compute graph into a hardware-specific execution plan, fusing layers and cutting redundancy to speed inference.
A new detection architecture that replaces YOLO as the backbone.
A cloud training framework that schedules multi-GPU distributed training.
optionExplanations: 标注是数据侧工具，TensorRT 与画框无关。
对；它把图重编译成硬件专属计划，融合层+选优 kernel 压推理延迟。
TensorRT 不是网络结构，它优化的是已有模型的执行，不替代 backbone。
它做的是推理部署优化，不是训练调度框架。
optionExplanations_en: Annotation is a data-side tool; TensorRT has nothing to do with drawing boxes.
Correct — it recompiles the graph into a hardware-specific plan, fusing layers and picking optimal kernels to cut inference latency.
TensorRT is not an architecture; it optimizes an existing model's execution and does not replace a backbone.
It optimizes inference deployment, not training scheduling.

termDefinitions.meaning: NVIDIA 的推理优化编译器：把模型图针对目标 GPU 重编译加速。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TensorRT is NVIDIA's inference compiler that recompiles a model graph for the target GPU to speed it up.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把相邻算子(如卷积+激活)合并成一个 kernel，减少内存往返、加速推理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Layer fusion merges adjacent operators like conv and activation into one kernel, cutting memory traffic and speeding inference.

scenario: 一张街景图里绝大多数候选区域是背景，真正的前景物体极少。
scenario_en: In a street scene, the vast majority of candidate regions are background and true foreground objects are rare.
q: 训练检测器时用 focal loss 解决什么问题？
q_en: What problem does focal loss solve when training a detector?
why: 一图里背景负样本压倒性多，普通交叉熵会被海量易分负样本淹没。focal loss 给已分对的样本乘一个衰减因子，down-weight 容易负样本，把梯度让给稀少难分的前景。
why_en: Backgrounds vastly outnumber objects so plain cross-entropy drowns in easy negatives; focal loss multiplies well-classified samples by a decay factor, down-weighting easy negatives so gradient focuses on rare hard foreground.
options: 解决多机训练时的梯度同步问题，用来加快分布式收敛
把输入图片压缩以适配边缘内存，是一种部署侧优化手段
给检测框做非极大值抑制，去掉同一物体上的重叠框
压低海量「容易的背景负样本」权重，让训练聚焦稀少前景，缓解前景-背景不平衡
options_en: It fixes gradient synchronization across machines to speed distributed convergence.
It compresses input images to fit edge memory, a deployment-side optimization.
It performs non-maximum suppression on boxes, removing overlaps on one object.
It down-weights the huge pool of easy background negatives so training focuses on the rare foreground, easing foreground-background imbalance.
optionExplanations: focal loss 是损失函数，与多机梯度同步无关。
它作用在训练损失上，不压缩图片，也不是部署优化。
去重叠框是 NMS 的活，发生在推理后处理，不是训练损失。
对；它衰减易分负样本、放大难分前景的梯度，专治极端类别不平衡。
optionExplanations_en: Focal loss is a loss function, unrelated to multi-machine gradient sync.
It acts on the training loss, not image compression, and is not a deployment optimization.
Removing overlaps is NMS at inference post-processing, not a training loss.
Correct — it decays easy negatives and amplifies gradient on hard foreground, targeting extreme class imbalance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种给已分对样本加衰减因子的损失，down-weight 易分负样本、聚焦难例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Focal loss adds a decay factor on well-classified samples, down-weighting easy negatives to focus on hard examples.

termDefinitions.term: foreground-background imbalance / 前景-背景不平衡
termDefinitions.meaning: 一图里背景候选远多于前景物体，导致普通损失被背景淹没。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Foreground-background imbalance is when background candidates vastly outnumber objects, drowning ordinary loss.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分类常用损失；在极端不平衡下会被大量易分负样本主导。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cross-entropy is the standard classification loss, dominated by many easy negatives under extreme imbalance.

scenario: 想让答案从「只懂架构」升级到「懂部署」，该点名哪些手段压边缘推理开销。
scenario_en: To move the answer from 'architecture only' to 'deployment-aware', which techniques cut edge inference cost?
q: 哪些做法能压低边缘推理的延迟或内存？(多选)
q_en: Which techniques reduce edge inference latency or memory? (multiple)
why: 前三个都直接减少 FLOPS/内存或去掉顺序步骤，压的是那 30ms 推理；堆分辨率和加深网络只会推高延迟，方向相反。
why_en: The first three cut FLOPs, memory, or serial steps to shrink the 30ms inference, while cranking resolution and depth pushes latency the wrong way.
options: 量化 FP32→INT8，减少内存与带宽、走低精度计算单元
用 TensorRT 把图编译成硬件专属计划、融合层
选单阶段检测器(YOLO/SSD)避免两阶段的顺序开销
增大输入分辨率并加深 backbone，把 mAP 堆到最高
options_en: Quantize FP32 to INT8 to cut memory and bandwidth and use low-precision compute units.
Use TensorRT to compile the graph into a hardware-specific plan and fuse layers.
Pick a single-stage detector (YOLO/SSD) to avoid two-stage serial overhead.
Increase input resolution and deepen the backbone to maximize mAP.
optionExplanations: 对；INT8 权重更小、带宽更低，还能走芯片低精度单元，直接缩推理。
对；层融合+消冗余+选优 kernel 是部署侧提速核心，专压那 30ms。
对；单阶段一次前向省掉区域提议这步，是卡进 30ms 的结构性选择。
错；加大分辨率、加深网络会推高 FLOPS 和延迟，与边缘预算相反。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — INT8 weights are smaller with less bandwidth and use low-precision units, directly shrinking inference.
Correct — fusion, redundancy elimination, and kernel selection are core deployment speedups targeting that 30ms.
Correct — single-stage's one pass drops the proposal step, a structural choice to fit 30ms.
Wrong — bigger resolution and deeper networks raise FLOPs and latency, opposite to the edge budget.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检测器提取特征的卷积网络主体；加深它会提高算力和延迟。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The backbone is the detector's feature-extraction network; deepening it raises compute and latency.

scenario: 安全关键系统里，漏检和误检的后果完全不对等。
scenario_en: In a safety-critical system, the costs of a miss and a false alarm are not symmetric.
q: 在 AV 检测里，false negative 和 false positive 哪个更该被优先压低？
q_en: In AV detection, which should you prioritize reducing — false negatives or false positives?
why: 代价不对称：漏检行人=规划栈拿不到目标、永不减速，可能致命；误检=多刹一脚，不适但能活。所以安全关键类要往高召回调，宁可多几次幻影刹车。
why_en: The costs are asymmetric: a missed pedestrian means the planner never brakes and can be fatal, while a phantom detection just means an unnecessary brake, so safety-critical classes are tuned for high recall.
tradeoff: 高召回压 FN(防致命漏检) vs 高精度压 FP(防幻影刹车、代价较轻)
diagram:
flowchart TB D["检测器输出"] --> FN["漏检 FN
真行人当背景"] --> X["规划永不刹车
可能致命"] D --> FP["误检 FP
阴影当障碍"] --> Y["多刹一脚
不适但可生还"]
options: false positive 更严重：幻影刹车会被追尾，必须优先消除，宁可漏检
两者代价基本对称，用一个全局置信度阈值平衡精度和召回即可
false negative 更严重：漏检真行人规划栈永不刹车、可能致命，所以优先保召回
都不关键，检测错了后面还有 LiDAR 兜底，阈值随便设都行
options_en: False positives are worse: phantom braking risks rear-ending, so eliminate them first even if you miss objects.
The costs are basically symmetric; one global confidence threshold balances precision and recall.
False negatives are worse: missing a real pedestrian means the planner never brakes and can be fatal, so prioritize recall.
Neither matters; LiDAR backs up detection errors, so thresholds can be set arbitrarily.
optionExplanations: 反了：漏检可能致命，误检只是多刹一脚，不能为省 FP 牺牲召回。
代价并不对称，单一全局阈值恰恰无法照顾行人这类高危漏检。
对；漏检致命、误检可生还，所以安全关键类往高召回调。
把安全全押在 LiDAR 兜底上不成立，相机漏检本身就是核心风险。
optionExplanations_en: Backwards: a miss can be fatal while a false alarm just brakes, so you cannot trade recall to cut FPs.
The costs are not symmetric, and one global threshold cannot protect high-risk misses like pedestrians.
Correct — a miss is fatal and a false alarm survivable, so safety-critical classes are tuned for high recall.
Betting safety on LiDAR backup fails; a camera miss is itself a core risk.

termDefinitions.meaning: 漏检：真实存在的物体没被检出，在 AV 里可能致命。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false negative (FN) is a real object the detector misses, potentially fatal in an AV.

termDefinitions.meaning: 误检：把不存在的物体报成障碍，导致不必要刹车。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false positive (FP) is a phantom object flagged as an obstacle, causing an unnecessary brake.

termDefinitions.meaning: 真实物体中被成功检出的比例，越高漏检越少。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall is the fraction of real objects successfully detected; higher means fewer misses.

termDefinitions.meaning: 报出的检测里真为物体的比例，越高误检越少。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Precision is the fraction of reported detections that are real; higher means fewer false alarms.

scenario: 行人检测器精度很高但偶尔漏人；有人提议调高阈值把误检清干净。
scenario_en: The pedestrian detector is high-precision but occasionally misses people; someone proposes raising the threshold to clean up false alarms.
q: 对行人这类安全关键类，该往哪个方向调？
q_en: For safety-critical classes like pedestrians, which way do you tune?
why: 安全关键类按不对称代价往高召回调：多几次幻影刹车可接受，漏一个行人不可接受。手段是给行人单独调低置信度阈值，而不是提高。
why_en: Safety-critical classes are tuned for high recall under asymmetric cost — extra phantom brakes are acceptable, a missed pedestrian is not — by lowering the pedestrian confidence threshold rather than raising it.
options: 往高召回调，宁可牺牲一点精度也不能漏人；漏检的代价远超多刹几脚
往高精度调，把置信度阈值提高，彻底消除幻影刹车最重要
保持默认全局阈值，行人和路锥一视同仁，避免偏袒
直接关掉行人类的检测，交给 LiDAR 专门处理最省事
options_en: Tune for high recall, accepting some precision loss rather than missing people, since a miss far outweighs a few extra brakes.
Tune for high precision, raising the threshold to eliminate phantom braking above all.
Keep the default global threshold, treating pedestrians and cones alike to avoid bias.
Just turn off the pedestrian class and let LiDAR handle it, the simplest option.
optionExplanations: 对；不对称代价下安全类要高召回，调低行人阈值防漏检。
提阈值会增加漏检，正好放大最致命的错误方向，不可取。
全局一视同仁做不到按类松紧，行人这类高危需要单独放宽。
关掉相机检测把安全全压在 LiDAR，冗余原则要求相机自身高召回。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — under asymmetric cost safety classes need high recall, so lower the pedestrian threshold to avoid misses.
Raising the threshold increases misses, amplifying the most fatal error direction.
A uniform global threshold cannot loosen per class, but high-risk pedestrians need their own relaxation.
Turning off camera detection bets all safety on LiDAR; redundancy demands the camera itself stay high-recall.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检测分数高于它才被判为有物体；调低提高召回，调高提高精度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A confidence threshold is the score above which a detection counts; lowering it raises recall, raising it raises precision.

scenario: 用一个全局置信度阈值时，要么行人漏检、要么路锥误报，顾此失彼。
scenario_en: With one global confidence threshold you either miss pedestrians or over-report traffic cones — you cannot win both.
q: 置信度阈值该怎么设？
q_en: How should you set the confidence thresholds?
why: 不同类代价不对称：漏行人致命、误报路锥只是多刹一脚，所以行人阈值调低(0.3)拉高召回、路锥调高(0.6)压误报。一个全局阈值做不到这种按类松紧。
why_en: Because class costs differ — a missed pedestrian is fatal, a false cone just brakes — you lower the pedestrian threshold to about 0.3 for recall and raise the cone threshold to about 0.6, which a single global threshold cannot express.
tradeoff: 类别专属阈值(贴合不对称代价、更安全) vs 全局阈值(简单但顾此失彼)
whenOtherWins: 当各类代价大致对称、且标注/调参预算有限时，单一全局阈值更简单可维护。
options: 用一个全局阈值(如 0.5)对所有类统一，简单、好维护、好解释
按类别分设阈值：行人 0.3 就触发、路锥要 0.6，用不对称代价定每类松紧
把所有类阈值都提到 0.9，只保留最有把握的检测，看起来最安全
干脆不设阈值，把所有候选框都输出，让规划栈自己去筛
options_en: Use one global threshold (e.g. 0.5) for all classes: simple, maintainable, explainable.
Set per-class thresholds: pedestrian fires at 0.3, cone requires 0.6, letting asymmetric cost set each class's strictness.
Raise every class threshold to 0.9, keeping only the most confident detections, which looks safest.
Set no threshold at all, output every candidate box, and let the planner filter.
optionExplanations: 全局阈值简单，但没法同时满足行人要松、路锥要紧的相反需求。
对；按类别的不对称代价分别设阈值，行人放宽保召回、路锥收紧压误报。
把行人也提到 0.9 会大量漏检，正是安全关键类最不该做的。
不设阈值把海量低质框全丢给规划栈，制造噪声与延迟，规划无法承受。
optionExplanations_en: A global threshold is simple but cannot meet the opposite needs of loose pedestrians and strict cones.
Correct — per-class thresholds from asymmetric cost loosen pedestrians for recall and tighten cones against false alarms.
Pushing pedestrians to 0.9 causes many misses, exactly what safety-critical classes must not do.
No threshold dumps a flood of low-quality boxes on the planner, creating noise and latency it cannot handle.

termDefinitions.term: class-specific threshold / 类别专属阈值
termDefinitions.meaning: 每个类用自己的置信度门槛，按该类漏检/误检的代价单独调松紧。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A class-specific threshold gives each class its own confidence cutoff, tuned to that class's miss and false-alarm costs.

scenario: 检测器对同一个物体给出中等置信度，但它离车的远近不同。
scenario_en: The detector gives medium confidence on the same object, but its distance to the car varies.
q: Time-to-Collision(TTC)怎么把置信度接到具体动作上？
q_en: How does Time-to-Collision (TTC) connect confidence to a concrete action?
why: TTC 把「多确信才动手」和「还剩多少时间」绑在一起：时间紧(0.5s)时即便置信不高也得先动、宁可误刹；时间宽(5s)时可以等跨帧确认降误报。同一置信度，动作因 TTC 不同。
why_en: TTC ties 'how sure before acting' to 'how much time is left': with 0.5s you act even on low confidence rather than wait, but with 5s you can hold for cross-frame confirmation, so the same confidence yields different actions.
diagram:
flowchart TB L["低置信 + TTC 0.5s"] --> A["立刻动作
来不及等确认"] S["同样置信 + TTC 5s"] --> W["等跨帧确认
再决定"]
options: TTC 只用来估算刹车距离，与检测置信度高低完全无关
TTC 越大代表越危险，应该立即刹车，不需要等待确认
低置信+TTC 0.5s→立刻动作，来不及等确认；同样置信+TTC 5s→等下一帧确认再决定
TTC 就是帧率的倒数，用来决定每秒能处理多少帧
options_en: TTC only estimates braking distance and is unrelated to detection confidence.
A larger TTC means more danger, so brake immediately without waiting for confirmation.
Low confidence with TTC 0.5s means act now with no time to confirm; the same confidence with TTC 5s means wait for the next frame to confirm.
TTC is the reciprocal of frame rate, deciding how many frames per second you process.
optionExplanations: TTC 恰恰是把置信度接到动作的桥梁，不是与置信无关的距离计算。
说反了：TTC 越小才越紧急；大 TTC 反而有时间等确认。
对；TTC 短就先动、宁可误刹，TTC 长就等跨帧确认降误报。
TTC 是碰撞剩余时间，不是帧率倒数，别混。
optionExplanations_en: TTC is precisely the bridge from confidence to action, not a distance calc unrelated to confidence.
Backwards: smaller TTC is more urgent; a large TTC leaves time to confirm.
Correct — short TTC means act now even risking a false brake, long TTC means wait for cross-frame confirmation.
TTC is time-to-collision, not the reciprocal of frame rate.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按当前相对速度撞上物体还剩多少时间，短则必须立刻反应。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTC (Time-to-Collision) is how long until impact at current closing speed; short TTC forces an immediate reaction.

scenario: 检测器老把阴影、路面标线、反光当成障碍物，误检不断。
scenario_en: The detector keeps flagging shadows, lane markings, and reflections as obstacles, producing steady false positives.
q: 怎么在不牺牲召回的前提下压低这些误检？
q_en: How do you cut these false positives without sacrificing recall?
why: hard negative mining=专门挑「检测器最容易误报成前景」的背景样本，过采样喂回训练，让它学会这些是背景。它针对性压 FP，又因为没动前景样本，不伤召回。
why_en: Hard negative mining oversamples the background patches the detector most often mistakes for objects — shadows, markings, reflections — and retrains on them, cutting false positives without touching recall.
options: 直接把全局置信度阈值调高，一刀切掉所有低分检测
减少训练集里的背景样本，让模型少见背景就少误判
关掉这些区域的检测，只在车道正中心检测物体
hard negative mining：把易混成前景的背景(阴影、标线、反光)过采样重训，教它们是背景
options_en: Just raise the global confidence threshold to cut off all low-score detections at once.
Reduce background samples in training so the model sees less background and misjudges less.
Turn off detection in those regions and only detect objects at the lane center.
Hard negative mining: oversample the confusable background (shadows, markings, reflections) and retrain to teach they are background.
optionExplanations: 提全局阈值会连真行人一起切掉，用召回换精度，安全类不能这么做。
反了：减少背景样本会让模型更认不清背景，误检更多。
关掉区域检测会漏掉真在那里的物体，制造致命 FN。
对；针对性过采样易混背景，压 FP 又不动前景样本、不伤召回。
optionExplanations_en: Raising the global threshold cuts real pedestrians too, trading recall for precision, which safety classes must not do.
Backwards: fewer background samples makes the model worse at recognizing background, increasing false positives.
Turning off region detection misses objects actually there, creating fatal false negatives.
Correct — targeted oversampling of confusable background cuts FPs without touching foreground or recall.

termDefinitions.term: hard negative mining / 难负样本挖掘
termDefinitions.meaning: 把模型最容易误报成前景的背景样本挑出来过采样重训，专门压误检。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hard negative mining picks the background samples the model most often flags as objects and oversamples them in retraining to cut false positives.

scenario: 模型在晴天加州数据上训练，效果很好；部署到雨夜后开始悄无声息地漏检。
scenario_en: Trained on sunny California data and working well, the model starts silently missing objects after deployment in rainy nights.
q: 为什么说 domain shift 是最危险的静默失败源？
q_en: Why is domain shift the most dangerous source of silent failures?
why: 危险在「静默」：雨夜、逆光、夜间行人不在训练分布里，模型漏检却不报错，而你的晴天 benchmark 分数依旧漂亮。缓解要靠定向采恶劣天气数据、域自适应、合成增强。
why_en: The danger is silence: rain, glare, and night pedestrians fall outside the training distribution so the model misses them without erroring while the sunny benchmark still looks great, needing targeted adverse-weather data, domain adaptation, and synthetic augmentation.
diagram:
flowchart LR Tr["训练：晴天加州"] --> Dep["部署：雨夜"] --> Miss["静默漏检 FN
标准 benchmark 看不出"]
options: 训练分布≠部署分布(晴天→雨夜)让模型悄悄漏检，标准 benchmark 又测不出，等于隐形致命 FN
domain shift 只影响推理速度，模型会变慢但检测精度照常
domain shift 指模型文件在不同硬件上格式不兼容，重编译即可解决
domain shift 会触发明显的运行时报错，日志里一眼就能看到
options_en: Training distribution differs from deployment (sunny to rainy night) so the model silently misses objects, invisible on standard benchmarks — a hidden fatal FN.
Domain shift only affects inference speed; the model slows down but accuracy stays the same.
Domain shift means the model file is format-incompatible across hardware, fixed by recompiling.
Domain shift triggers obvious runtime errors that show up immediately in the logs.
optionExplanations: 对；分布偏移下模型不报错地漏检，晴天 benchmark 还高分，是隐形致命风险。
它影响的是精度而非速度：分布外样本被漏检，不是变慢。
这是硬件兼容问题，和数据分布偏移完全无关。
恰恰相反，domain shift 不报错，正因为静默才最危险。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — under distribution shift the model misses without erroring while the sunny benchmark still scores high, a hidden fatal risk.
It affects accuracy not speed: out-of-distribution objects are missed, not slowed.
That is a hardware-compatibility issue, unrelated to data distribution shift.
The opposite: domain shift throws no error, and its silence is exactly what makes it most dangerous.

termDefinitions.meaning: 部署数据分布偏离训练分布(如晴天→雨夜)，导致模型静默失效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Domain shift is when deployment data drifts from the training distribution (sunny to rainy night), causing silent failure.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让模型适应新分布的技术，如用目标域数据微调或对齐特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Domain adaptation makes a model fit a new distribution, e.g. by fine-tuning on target-domain data or aligning features.

scenario: 检测器偶尔把邮筒、消防栓误报成行人，导致车做保守急停。
scenario_en: The detector occasionally reports a mailbox or hydrant as a pedestrian, causing a conservative hard stop.
q: 这类「类别混淆」型误检该怎么缓解？
q_en: How do you mitigate this 'class confusion' type of false positive?
why: 类别混淆(邮筒当行人)是形状相似导致，缓解靠数据多样性覆盖相似物、多尺度特征图提升判别力、再用类别阈值收口。它属中低危 FP：后果是保守急停，不致命但影响体验。
why_en: Class confusion like a mailbox read as a pedestrian comes from similar shapes, mitigated by diverse data, multi-scale feature maps, and class thresholds; it is a low-to-moderate FP causing a conservative stop, uncomfortable but not fatal.
options: 把行人这个类别彻底删掉，没有这个类就不会混淆了
用更多样训练数据+多尺度特征图+类别专属阈值，让模型更好区分相似外形
把全局阈值提到 0.95，牺牲所有召回来换取零误报
直接忽略，邮筒被当成行人只是多刹一脚，完全无害
options_en: Delete the pedestrian class entirely; with no such class there is no confusion.
Use more diverse data, multi-scale feature maps, and class-specific thresholds so the model better distinguishes similar shapes.
Raise the global threshold to 0.95, sacrificing all recall for zero false alarms.
Just ignore it; a mailbox read as a pedestrian only causes an extra brake and is harmless.
optionExplanations: 删掉行人类会直接漏掉真行人，制造最致命的 FN，绝不可行。
对；数据多样性+多尺度特征+类别阈值直击相似外形的判别问题。
0.95 全局阈值会大量漏检行人，用致命 FN 换零 FP 得不偿失。
虽不致命但频繁保守急停会被追尾、损害体验，不能放任。
optionExplanations_en: Deleting the pedestrian class misses real pedestrians, creating the most fatal FN, and is unacceptable.
Correct — diverse data, multi-scale features, and class thresholds directly attack similar-shape discrimination.
A 0.95 global threshold misses many pedestrians, trading fatal FNs for zero FPs, a bad deal.
Not fatal, but frequent conservative stops risk rear-ends and hurt ride quality, so it cannot be ignored.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一类物体误判成另一类(邮筒当行人)，多因外形相似。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Class confusion is misclassifying one object as another (mailbox as pedestrian), usually from similar shapes.

termDefinitions.term: multi-scale feature map / 多尺度特征图
termDefinitions.meaning: 在多个分辨率层上提取特征，兼顾大小物体、提升判别力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Multi-scale feature maps extract features at several resolutions, handling large and small objects and improving discrimination.

scenario: 行人召回不够，团队争论：是重训模型，还是改线上阈值？给定当前模型不变，要快速降低漏检。
scenario_en: Pedestrian recall is too low and the team debates retraining versus changing thresholds; with the current model fixed, you must cut misses fast.
q: 类别专属阈值属于哪一类缓解手段？
q_en: What kind of mitigation are class-specific thresholds?
why: 类别专属阈值是在推理输出端做的：模型和权重都不动，只把行人的判定门槛调低。它当天可上线，是 Staff+ 强调的「服务时缓解」，区别于重训、补数据这类训练时修复。
why_en: Class-specific thresholds act at the serving output — the model and weights stay frozen, you just lower the decision bar for pedestrians — so it ships same-day as a serving-time fix, distinct from retraining or re-collecting data.
tradeoff: serving-time 调阈值(不重训、当天上线) vs training-time 重训(改根因但慢、贵)
whenOtherWins: 若模型本身就学不出行人特征(特征表达不足)，调阈值也救不了，这时才必须回到训练时——补数据、改损失。
options: 训练时手段：必须重训模型、改损失函数才能实现
数据手段：要重新采集并标注一大批行人数据才行
serving-time(推理/部署时)手段：不动模型，只在输出端按类调阈值，是服务时而非训练时的修复
硬件手段：换一块更强的边缘芯片就能自动提升召回
options_en: A training-time fix: it requires retraining the model and changing the loss function.
A data fix: it requires re-collecting and labeling a large batch of pedestrian data.
A serving-time fix: the model is untouched and you just adjust per-class thresholds at the output — a serving-time, not training-time, mitigation.
A hardware fix: swapping in a stronger edge chip automatically raises recall.
optionExplanations: 调阈值根本不碰权重和损失，不属于训练时手段。
它无需任何新数据，只改输出门槛，和采标数据无关。
对；纯输出端调阈值、模型冻结，是当天可上线的服务时缓解。
换芯片只影响速度，不会改变模型的召回，也不需要。
optionExplanations_en: Adjusting thresholds never touches weights or loss, so it is not a training-time fix.
It needs no new data, only an output cutoff change, unrelated to data collection.
Correct — a pure output-side threshold change with the model frozen ships same-day as a serving-time mitigation.
Swapping chips affects speed, not recall, and is unnecessary here.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在推理/部署阶段做的修复(如调阈值)，不重训模型，能快速上线。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A serving-time mitigation is a fix applied at inference (like threshold tuning) without retraining, deployable fast.

termDefinitions.meaning: 改数据或损失、重训模型的修复，治根因但慢且贵。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A training-time fix changes data or loss and retrains the model, addressing root cause but slow and costly.

q: 把「行人召回不够→怎么办」的 scoping 决策链排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the 'pedestrian recall too low → what to do' scoping decision chain.
steps: 代价：更多幻影刹车(FP) → 用时序一致性过滤 + hard negative mining 压下去
识别不对称代价：漏检行人可能致命，误检只是多刹一脚
把行人的置信度阈值调低到约 0.3，换取更高召回
由此定设计目标：安全关键类要高召回，宁可牺牲一点精度
why: 决策链：先认清漏检行人的代价远超误检→推出「安全类高召回」目标→落到把行人阈值调低这个具体动作→再收尾它的代价(更多 FP)并用时序过滤/hard negative mining 兜住。
why_en: The chain runs from recognizing a missed pedestrian costs far more than a false brake, to the high-recall goal, to lowering the pedestrian threshold, then closing on its cost with temporal filtering and hard negative mining.
diagram:
flowchart TB C["不对称代价
漏检行人致命"] --> G["目标：安全类高召回"] --> Th["调低行人阈值 0.3"] --> Cost["代价：更多幻影刹车
→时序过滤+hard neg"]

termDefinitions.term: temporal consistency filtering / 时序一致性过滤
termDefinitions.meaning: 要求同一检测在连续多帧稳定出现才确认，压掉一闪而过的误检。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Temporal consistency filtering confirms a detection only if it persists across consecutive frames, cutting flicker false positives.

scenario: 行人检测器目前精度 95%、召回 88%；有人提议调低阈值把召回拉上来，但精度会掉。
scenario_en: The pedestrian detector is at 95% precision and 88% recall; someone proposes lowering the threshold to raise recall even though precision will drop.
q: 该不该为了提召回而牺牲精度？
q_en: Should you trade precision for recall here?
why: 12% 的漏检(recall 88%)里每一个都可能是没刹住的行人，代价是致命的；调低阈值多出的 FP 只是多刹几脚。不对称代价下，提召回正当。
why_en: Each of the 12% missed pedestrians could be one you fail to brake for, which is fatal, while the extra false positives just cause a few unnecessary brakes, so under asymmetric cost raising recall is justified.
tradeoff: 提召回(少漏致命行人、代价是多几次幻影刹车) vs 保精度(少幻影刹车、代价是漏检风险)
whenOtherWins: 若这个类误检本身代价很高(例如误刹会在高速追尾致命)、或下游对 FP 极敏感，那就该保精度、别盲目提召回。
options: 不该：精度更值钱，宁可漏检也不能增加幻影刹车
该：漏检行人(FN)的代价远超幻影刹车(FP)，所以即便掉精度，提召回也是对的
都不该动：95/88 已经够好，任何调整都是过度优化
应该反过来调高阈值，把精度冲到 99%，召回不重要
options_en: No: precision is more valuable, so accept misses rather than more phantom braking.
Yes: a missed pedestrian (FN) costs far more than phantom braking (FP), so raising recall is right even at precision cost.
Neither: 95/88 is already good enough and any change is over-optimization.
The opposite: raise the threshold to push precision to 99%; recall does not matter.
optionExplanations: 把精度看得比人命重，方向错了：漏检行人才是最致命的错误。
对；不对称代价下 12% 漏检可能致命，提召回换来的多刹几脚可接受。
88% 召回意味着 12% 行人被漏，在安全关键场景绝非「够好」。
提阈值会进一步压低召回、漏更多行人，正好放大致命风险。
optionExplanations_en: Valuing precision over lives is the wrong direction: a missed pedestrian is the most fatal error.
Correct — under asymmetric cost the 12% missed can be fatal, and the extra brakes from higher recall are acceptable.
88% recall means 12% of pedestrians are missed, far from 'good enough' in a safety-critical setting.
Raising the threshold cuts recall further and misses more pedestrians, amplifying the fatal risk.

termDefinitions.term: precision-recall tradeoff / 精度-召回权衡
termDefinitions.meaning: 调低阈值提召回但降精度，调高则相反；安全类偏向高召回。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The precision-recall tradeoff: lowering the threshold raises recall but cuts precision and vice versa, with safety classes favoring recall.

q: 补全 AV 检测的安全调参逻辑：
q_en: Fill in the safety-tuning logic for AV detection.
text: 行人检测里，{{漏检}}可能致命而误检只是多刹一脚，所以对安全关键类要调{{高}}召回，用{{类别专属}}置信度阈值而不是一个全局阈值。
text_en: For pedestrians a {{false negative}} can be fatal while a false positive just means extra braking, so tune for {{high}} recall on safety-critical classes using {{class-specific}} thresholds instead of one global threshold.
why: 一句话记住 AV 检测的调参主轴：不对称代价→安全类高召回→类别专属阈值。这条链是 L5 及以上的核心得分点。
why_en: The core tuning axis for AV detection is asymmetric cost leading to high recall on safety classes via class-specific thresholds, the key scoring point from L5 up.

termDefinitions.meaning: 漏检：真物体没被检出，在 AV 里可能致命。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false negative (FN) is a real object missed, potentially fatal in an AV.

scenario: 关键危险场景(小孩突然窜出、轮椅使用者过路口、黄昏动物)在自然驾驶里极其罕见。
scenario_en: Critical scenarios (a child darting out, a wheelchair user at an intersection, an animal at dusk) are extremely rare in naturalistic driving.
q: 稀有事件的长尾特性给数据集构建带来什么根本难题？
q_en: What fundamental problem does the long tail of rare events pose for dataset construction?
why: 长尾=极少数致命场景样本严重不足。车队跑再多，收到的绝大多数还是常规高速帧，小孩窜出这种关键帧近乎为零，模型没足够样本学会应对。这是安全覆盖的核心缺口。
why_en: The long tail means the few fatal scenarios are severely undersampled — however far the fleet drives, almost every frame is routine and critical ones are near zero, so the model lacks samples to learn them.
options: 长尾意味着数据量太大存不下，本质是存储和带宽问题
长尾意味着标注速度太慢，多雇标注人手就能解决
关键危险场景在自然行驶里几乎不出现，车队日志全是常规帧、近乎零关键帧，缺样本学致命场景
长尾意味着类别数量太多，把类别合并减少就能解决
options_en: The long tail means the data is too big to store; it is fundamentally a storage and bandwidth problem.
The long tail means labeling is too slow, solvable by hiring more annotators.
Critical scenarios almost never occur while driving, so fleet logs are all routine frames with near-zero critical ones, starving the model of samples for fatal cases.
The long tail means too many classes, solvable by merging classes to reduce their count.
optionExplanations: 问题不在存不下，而在关键场景根本没被采到，是分布问题不是容量问题。
多雇人也没用：日志里就没有足够关键帧可标，缺的是样本不是标注工。
对；长尾使致命场景样本近乎为零，模型学不到，构成安全覆盖缺口。
合并类别不改变关键场景稀缺的事实，只是掩盖问题。
optionExplanations_en: The issue is not storage but that critical scenes are never captured — a distribution problem, not capacity.
More annotators do not help: the logs lack critical frames to label; the gap is samples, not labor.
Correct — the long tail leaves fatal-scene samples near zero so the model cannot learn them, a safety-coverage gap.
Merging classes does not change the scarcity of critical scenes; it only masks the problem.

termDefinitions.meaning: 少数常见事件占绝大多数样本，大量罕见但关键的事件各自极少。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A long-tail distribution has a few common events dominating samples while many rare but critical events each appear very rarely.

scenario: 有人提议「多收数据就行」——把车队规模翻倍来覆盖稀有场景。
scenario_en: Someone proposes 'just collect more data' — double the fleet size to cover rare scenarios.
q: 为什么「多收数据」解决不了稀有事件缺口？
q_en: Why doesn't 'collect more data' solve the rare-event gap?
why: 稀有事件服从幂律：样本量翻倍，尾部实例几乎不增。所以粗放「多收」只堆常规帧，得靠合成数据、主动学习、定向标注去专门捞尾部——这属于 scoping 阶段就要识别的设计风险。
why_en: Rare events follow a power law, so doubling data barely adds tail instances — bulk collection just piles on routine frames, which is why you need synthetic data, active learning, and targeted annotation, a design risk to flag during scoping.
options: 因为幂律分布：翻倍车队只是翻倍常规高速帧，可能一个新的尾部实例都不增加，稀有场景不会因量大自动出现
因为收更多数据会撑爆边缘设备内存，导致线上推理变慢
因为标注预算有限，收了也标不完，这跟数据分布无关
因为公开数据集已经足够用，自己再收纯属浪费资源
options_en: Because of the power law: doubling the fleet just doubles routine highway frames and may add zero new tail instances, so rare scenes do not appear from sheer volume.
Because collecting more data overflows edge-device memory and slows down inference.
Because the labeling budget is limited so you cannot label it all, unrelated to distribution.
Because public datasets already suffice, so collecting your own is a waste.
optionExplanations: 对；幂律下扩量只增常规帧、尾部几乎不动，所以粗放收集治不了缺口。
内存问题和「多收能否补尾部」无关，混淆了部署与数据分布。
预算确实有限，但根因是分布而非标注产能，方向说偏了。
公开集同样欠采样长尾，不能替代针对稀有场景的自采。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — under a power law more volume only adds routine frames while the tail barely moves, so bulk collection cannot close the gap.
Memory is unrelated to whether more data fills the tail; it conflates deployment with distribution.
Budget is limited, but the root cause is distribution not labeling capacity, so this misses the point.
Public sets also undersample the long tail and cannot replace targeted collection of rare scenes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 少数常见事件占绝大多数，尾部罕见事件出现概率随量级快速衰减。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A power-law distribution has a few common events dominating while rare tail events drop off sharply, so scaling volume barely adds them.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让模型挑出最不确定/最有价值的样本优先标注，高效捞长尾。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Active learning has the model pick the most uncertain or valuable samples to label first, efficiently mining the long tail.

scenario: 数据集要标注框；2D 图像框和 3D LiDAR 融合框成本差一个量级。
scenario_en: The dataset needs annotated boxes; 2D image boxes and 3D LiDAR-fused boxes differ by an order of magnitude in cost.
q: 「3D LiDAR 框比 2D 框贵~10×」这个数字对数据策略意味着什么？
q_en: What does '3D LiDAR boxes cost about 10x a 2D box' imply for data strategy?
why: ~10× 是经验成本比、不是公式：3D LiDAR 框要专用标注工具和受训标注员，逐帧全上 3D 会烧穿预算。它是「标注预算 vs 安全覆盖」这个 Staff+ 组织权衡的输入——决定哪些帧值得上 3D。
why_en: The ~10x is an empirical cost ratio, not a formula — 3D LiDAR boxes need specialized tooling and trained annotators, so labeling every frame in 3D burns the budget, feeding the Staff-plus tradeoff of annotation budget versus safety coverage.
options: 说明应该只标 3D 框，2D 框没价值，反正两者差不多贵
说明标注成本可以忽略，2D 和 3D 都很便宜，随便标就行
3D LiDAR 融合框每帧约是 2D 框 10 倍成本(需专用工具+训练过标注员)，标注预算要按价值分配
说明 3D 框其实更便宜，因为 LiDAR 能自动生成、不用人标
options_en: It means label only 3D boxes since 2D boxes are worthless and both cost about the same.
It means annotation cost is negligible; 2D and 3D are both cheap, so label freely.
A 3D LiDAR-fused box costs about 10x a 2D box per frame (specialized tooling plus trained annotators), so allocate the labeling budget by value.
It means 3D boxes are actually cheaper because LiDAR auto-generates them without human labeling.

termDefinitions.meaning: 激光测距生成 3D 点云的传感器；用它标 3D 框需专用工具，成本高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) builds a 3D point cloud with lasers; labeling 3D boxes on it needs special tooling and costs more.

termDefinitions.meaning: 带深度和朝向的立体框，比 2D 图像框标注贵约 10 倍。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A 3D bounding box has depth and orientation and costs roughly 10x a 2D image box to annotate.

scenario: 团队想只靠 Waymo Open Dataset、nuScenes 这些公开基准来证明安全性。
scenario_en: The team wants to prove safety using only public benchmarks like the Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes.
q: 只靠公开基准数据集评估 AV 检测安全性，风险在哪？
q_en: What is the risk of judging AV detection safety only on public benchmarks?
why: Waymo Open、nuScenes 也欠采样长尾：它们的边缘场景不足，模型在上面拿高分仍可能在雨夜漏检。所以公开基准只能当基线，安全覆盖得靠自采的定向恶劣场景数据补。
why_en: Public sets like the Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes also underrepresent the long tail, so a high score there can still hide rain-and-night misses, which is why they are a baseline while safety coverage needs your own targeted edge-case data.
options: 公开基准数据集太大，跑一遍评估太慢，会拖累迭代速度
公开基准同样欠采样边缘场景(雨夜、罕见物体)，分数好看≠安全，不能单独当安全依据
公开基准里全是合成数据，和真实路况完全没有关系
公开基准只提供 2D 框，根本没法评估任何检测模型
options_en: Public benchmarks are too large, so evaluating on them is slow and drags iteration.
Public benchmarks also underrepresent edge cases (rain, night, rare objects), so a good score is not safety and cannot be the sole basis.
Public benchmarks are all synthetic data with no relation to real road conditions.
Public benchmarks only provide 2D boxes, so they cannot evaluate any detector.
optionExplanations: 评估慢不是安全风险，也不是这里的核心问题。
对；公开集欠采样长尾，高分可能掩盖雨夜漏检，只能当基线不能当安全证明。
公开集多为真实采集，不是全合成，这条说法不成立。
Waymo/nuScenes 都含 3D 标注，能评估检测，这条与事实不符。
optionExplanations_en: Slow evaluation is not a safety risk and not the core issue here.
Correct — public sets undersample the long tail, so a high score can hide rain-night misses; they are a baseline, not proof of safety.
Public sets are mostly real-world capture, not all synthetic, so this is false.
Waymo and nuScenes include 3D annotations and can evaluate detection, so this is factually wrong.

termDefinitions.meaning: Waymo 公开的自动驾驶感知数据集，含相机与 LiDAR 标注。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Waymo Open Dataset is Waymo's public autonomous-driving perception dataset with camera and LiDAR annotations.

termDefinitions.meaning: 含多传感器(相机+LiDAR+雷达)标注的公开自动驾驶数据集。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: nuScenes is a public autonomous-driving dataset with multi-sensor (camera, LiDAR, radar) annotations.

scenario: 面试限时，你在框定 AV 检测系统的需求；是先谈稀有事件数据缺口，还是等做完模型再说？
scenario_en: Time-boxed in the interview, you are scoping the AV detection system — raise the rare-event data gap now, or after the model?
q: 稀有事件数据缺口应该在什么阶段提出？
q_en: At what stage should the rare-event data gap be raised?
why: 稀有事件缺口决定你要不要合成数据、主动学习、怎么评估安全——这些是架构级决定，拖到后面就是返工。在 scoping 就点出它，正是 L5/Staff+ 与 L4 的分水岭。
why_en: The rare-event gap decides whether you need synthetic data, active learning, and how to evaluate safety — all architecture-level calls — so raising it during scoping rather than as an afterthought separates L5 and Staff-plus from L4.
tradeoff: scoping 阶段提(定方向、显 Staff+ 视野) vs 事后补(返工、可能已出安全事故)
whenOtherWins: 若这就是纯建模练习、数据集已给定固定，那把数据缺口留到后面谈也无妨——但 AV 安全题里几乎不成立。
options: 等模型训练完、看到漏检指标变差后，再当作数据问题去补
等部署上线，靠线上监控发现漏检了，再回头补这批数据
根本不用提，那是下一个团队的数据工程活，不属系统设计
在需求 scoping 阶段就当核心设计风险提出，它决定数据策略、评估方式和整体可行性
options_en: Wait until the model is trained and recall metrics look bad, then patch it as a data problem.
Wait until deployment, catch misses via monitoring, then go back and collect the data.
No need to raise it; that is the next team's data engineering, not system design.
Raise it during requirements scoping as a core design risk, since it drives data strategy, evaluation, and overall feasibility.
optionExplanations: 训练后才发现就得重做数据管线和评估，是最贵的返工。
上线后靠监控发现漏检，可能已经酿成安全事故，太晚。
把它推给别的团队等于回避了这题最关键的设计风险。
对；它是架构级决定的输入，scoping 就点出才显 L5/Staff+ 视野。
optionExplanations_en: Discovering it post-training forces reworking the data pipeline and evaluation, the costliest redo.
Catching misses via monitoring after launch may mean a safety incident already happened — too late.
Pushing it to another team dodges the single most critical design risk of this question.
Correct — it feeds architecture-level decisions, so raising it during scoping shows L5/Staff-plus range.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用仿真或生成模型造出的训练数据，用来补稀有场景样本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Synthetic data is generated or simulated training data used to fill in rare-scenario samples.

scenario: 同一道 AV 检测题，L4 和 L5 候选人的答法差在哪。
scenario_en: On the same AV detection question, how do L4 and L5 candidates differ?
q: 相比 L4，L5 的答案会额外覆盖什么？
q_en: Compared to L4, what does an L5 answer additionally cover?
why: L5=L4(识别任务+单阶段+延迟意识+mAP/FPS)之上，补齐延迟预算拆解、不对称代价与类别阈值、边缘部署约束、把稀有事件当设计风险。区别是 scoping 的深度，不是模型更花哨。
why_en: L5 builds on L4 by adding explicit latency-budget decomposition, asymmetric-cost analysis with class thresholds, edge constraints like quantization and TensorRT, and treating the rare-event gap as a design risk — depth of scoping, not fancier models.
options: 明确的 50ms 预算拆解、不对称代价+类别阈值、边缘约束(量化/TensorRT)、稀有事件缺口
只要把模型换成更大的 YOLOv8、把 mAP 分数刷得更高就是 L5
加一段自我介绍和项目经历，充分展示沟通能力就够了
把所有公式推导都写全，展示扎实的数学功底就到 L5
options_en: Explicit 50ms budget decomposition, asymmetric cost plus class thresholds, edge constraints (quantization/TensorRT), and the rare-event gap.
Just swap in a bigger YOLOv8 and push mAP higher to be L5.
Add a self-intro and project history to fully show communication skills.
Write out every formula derivation to demonstrate solid math and reach L5.
optionExplanations: 对；这四项正是 L5 在 L4 之上补的 scoping 深度。
换更大模型是模型 trivia，不是 scoping 深度，评不到 L5。
沟通有用但不是这题的技术分级依据。
堆公式不等于系统 scoping，分级看的是需求覆盖广度深度。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — these four are exactly the scoping depth L5 adds over L4.
A bigger model is model trivia, not scoping depth, and does not reach L5.
Communication helps but is not the technical leveling basis for this question.
Piling on formulas is not system scoping; leveling tracks breadth and depth of requirements.

termDefinitions.meaning: 工程职级：越高越要展示系统与组织级的需求 scoping，而非更花哨的模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: L4, L5, and Staff-plus are engineering levels; higher levels demand system- and org-level scoping, not fancier models.

scenario: 什么样的回答会被判到 Staff+ 而不只是 L5。
scenario_en: What kind of answer reads as Staff-plus rather than just L5.
q: AV 检测题里，Staff+ 会额外谈哪些系统级内容？
q_en: On the AV detection question, what system-level content does Staff-plus add?
why: Staff+ 跳出单模型，谈系统与组织：感知怎么喂规划、多传感器融合、域偏移怎么治、用主动学习搭数据飞轮、以及标注预算和安全覆盖如何权衡。视野从「模型」升到「系统+组织」。
why_en: Staff-plus zooms out from the model to system and org level — how perception feeds planning, multi-sensor fusion, domain-shift mitigation, an active-learning data flywheel, and trading annotation budget against safety coverage.
options: 把 batch size 和学习率调到最优，充分展示炼丹调参经验
把每个 CUDA kernel 都手写优化一遍，展示底层性能功力
感知→规划整合、多传感器融合(相机+LiDAR+雷达)、域偏移缓解、数据飞轮、标注预算 vs 安全覆盖权衡
把 UI 和可视化调试面板设计好，方便工程师日常排查
options_en: Tune batch size and learning rate optimally to show hyperparameter craft.
Hand-optimize every CUDA kernel to show low-level performance skill.
Perception-to-planning integration, multi-sensor fusion (camera+LiDAR+radar), domain-shift mitigation, a data flywheel, and annotation budget vs safety coverage tradeoffs.
Design a nice UI and visualization dashboard so engineers can debug daily.
optionExplanations: 调参是模型内部功夫，不是系统/组织级 scoping。
手写 kernel 是底层优化，评不出 Staff+ 的系统视野。
对；这些是感知在整车系统与组织里的整合，正是 Staff+ 的标志。
调试面板是工具，不涉及安全系统的架构与组织权衡。
optionExplanations_en: Hyperparameter tuning is model-internal craft, not system- or org-level scoping.
Hand-writing kernels is low-level optimization, not the Staff-plus system view.
Correct — these integrate perception into the whole-vehicle system and org, the Staff-plus signature.
A debug dashboard is tooling, not the architecture and org tradeoffs of a safety system.

termDefinitions.term: sensor fusion / 多传感器融合
termDefinitions.meaning: 把相机、LiDAR、雷达等多源感知合并，互补弱点、提升鲁棒性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sensor fusion combines camera, LiDAR, and radar so their weaknesses offset and robustness improves.

termDefinitions.meaning: 部署→采到难例→标注→重训→更好模型的自我强化循环，用主动学习驱动。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A data flywheel is the self-reinforcing loop of deploy, mine hard cases, label, retrain, better model, driven by active learning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用无线电波测距测速的传感器，在雨雾夜间比相机更稳。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Radar uses radio waves to measure range and speed, more robust than cameras in rain, fog, and night.

q: 补全 AV 检测题的分级 scoping 阶梯：
q_en: Fill in the leveling ladder for the AV detection question.
text: L4 只{{识别任务}}并选单阶段检测器；L5 补上 {{50ms}} 延迟预算拆解、不对称代价和边缘约束；Staff+ 再加{{多传感器融合}}、域偏移缓解和数据飞轮。
text_en: L4 just {{identifies the task}} and picks a single-stage detector; L5 adds {{50ms}} latency-budget decomposition, asymmetric cost, and edge constraints; Staff+ adds {{multi-sensor fusion}}, domain-shift mitigation, and a data flywheel.
why: 一条阶梯记住分级：L4 识别任务、L5 加延迟预算+不对称代价+边缘约束、Staff+ 加多传感器融合+域偏移+数据飞轮。往上走的是 scoping 的广度和深度。
why_en: The ladder: L4 identifies the task, L5 adds the latency budget plus asymmetric cost and edge constraints, and Staff-plus adds multi-sensor fusion, domain shift, and a data flywheel — breadth and depth of scoping.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把端到端时限(50ms)拆到各处理阶段的分配表，用来定位优化点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A latency budget allocates the end-to-end limit (50ms) across processing stages to locate where to optimize.

scenario: 候选人纠结要不要背更多检测网络名字来显得厉害。
scenario_en: A candidate wonders whether memorizing more detector names will look impressive.
q: 在这道题里，真正区分级别的是什么？
q_en: On this question, what actually separates the levels?
why: 分级看的是你把需求想多深多全：延迟预算、不对称安全代价、边缘部署、稀有数据缺口——不是能背几个 YOLO 版本。所以答题重心放在 scoping，不是模型选型。
why_en: Levels track how deeply and broadly you scope requirements — latency budget, asymmetric safety cost, edge deployment, data gaps — not how many detector names you can recite, so spend your answer on scoping.
options: 记住的检测网络名字越多越高级，模型 trivia 才是关键
需求 scoping 的深度和广度——延迟预算、安全代价、边缘约束、数据缺口——不是模型 trivia
谁能把公开数据集的 mAP 刷得最高，谁的级别就最高
谁在白板上写的伪代码行数最多，谁就最资深
options_en: The more detector names you memorize the higher your level; model trivia is the key.
Depth and breadth of requirements scoping — latency budget, safety cost, edge constraints, data gaps — not model trivia.
Whoever pushes the public-dataset mAP highest is the most senior.
Whoever writes the most lines of pseudocode on the whiteboard is the most senior.
optionExplanations: 背模型名字是 trivia，恰恰是这题明确说不能区分级别的东西。
对；分级看需求覆盖的深度广度，scoping 才是重心。
刷 mAP 是单点指标优化，公开集还欠采样长尾，评不出资深度。
写更多伪代码不等于更好的系统设计，行数不是分级依据。
optionExplanations_en: Memorizing model names is trivia, exactly what this question says does not separate levels.
Correct — leveling tracks depth and breadth of requirement coverage, so scoping is the focus.
Chasing mAP is single-metric optimization on a long-tail-poor public set, not a seniority signal.
More pseudocode is not better system design; line count is not a leveling basis.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只堆检测网络名字/刷分，缺少系统级需求 scoping，是分级里的低信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Model trivia is piling on detector names or scores without system-level scoping, a weak leveling signal.
